findings.evidenceJa: 全ての針が頂点を指す
findings.governingReading: Every hand points to the top of the clock at the appointed instant.
findings.explanation: The English replaces the visual convergence of all hands with an audible clock strike.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に言われたペンダント
findings.governingReading: The pendant is the one object Rin told Shirou to bring.
findings.explanation: The English retains the object but removes Rin’s instruction and its planned role.

findings.evidenceJa: イリヤに残ってもらうのは俺の希望
findings.governingReading: Having Illya remain behind is also Shirou’s own wish or preference.
findings.explanation: The English makes Illya herself his hope, changing a concrete protective decision into an abstract emotional role.

findings.evidenceJa: 生物としての機能
findings.governingReading: Shirou is losing functions as a living organism.
findings.explanation: The English narrows the category to vaguely defined “human functionality,” weakening the biological deterioration.

findings.evidenceJa: 少しずつこそぎ落ちている
findings.governingReading: His biological functions are being scraped or pared away little by little.
findings.explanation: The English loses the incremental violent removal and uses generic erosion.

findings.evidenceJa: 夜が明ける頃に
findings.governingReading: Illya asks them to return around the time dawn breaks.
findings.explanation: The English turns an approximate reunion time into a before-dawn deadline.

findings.evidenceJa: ごうごうと強く大気を蹴る音
findings.governingReading: Shirou hears a roaring sound that seems to kick or beat violently through the air.
findings.explanation: The English reduces the forceful acoustic image to ordinary howling wind.

findings.highlight: If we want the Great Holy Grail
findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争の大聖杯に行こう
findings.governingReading: Rin says that to go to the Holy Grail War’s Greater Grail, they must descend.
findings.explanation: The English changes a destination into wanting possession of the Greater Grail.

findings.evidenceJa: 山の中へ入っていく
findings.governingReading: They enter the mountain interior relying on moonlight.
findings.explanation: The English adds upward travel and loses movement into the mountain.

findings.evidenceJa: むイリヤの話じゃ
findings.governingReading: Rin’s small hesitation or thinking sound precedes “according to Illya.”
findings.explanation: The English leaves malformed revision debris at the beginning of the sentence.

findings.evidenceJa: 落とし穴ってワケでもない
findings.governingReading: Rin jokes that an entrance surely would not be a pitfall.
findings.explanation: The English removes the trap mechanism and turns it into an ordinary pit.

findings.evidenceJa: 冬の枯れ木
findings.governingReading: The area is filled with winter-bare or withered trees.
findings.explanation: The English certifies the trees as dead, losing the seasonal reading.

findings.highlight: There’s no sign of human influence
findings.evidenceJa: 人工物なんて当然なく
findings.governingReading: There are naturally no artificial or manufactured objects nearby.
findings.explanation: The English expands absence of objects into absence of any human influence.

findings.evidenceJa: チロチロと流れる小川
findings.governingReading: The little stream visibly trickles through the clearing.
findings.explanation: The English removes its slight continuous motion, which helps Shirou locate the spring.

findings.highlight: Following the sound of water, I figure out which direction to search
findings.evidenceJa: 水の音を頼りに目を凝らす
findings.governingReading: Using the sound as a guide, Shirou strains his eyes to see.
findings.explanation: The English replaces active visual scrutiny with deciding a search direction.

findings.evidenceJa: 岩が重なりあった地面
findings.governingReading: The stream wells from ground formed by overlapping rocks.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes a projecting rock formation and loses the layered ground geometry.

findings.highlight: a crack big enough for one person to fit through
findings.evidenceJa: 人間一人がようやく入れる程度の隙間
findings.governingReading: The gap is only barely large enough for a single person to enter.
findings.explanation: The English removes the tightness and effort implied by “barely.”

findings.highlight: a huge boulder is blocking the entrance
findings.evidenceJa: 中に入ったところですぐに岩にぶつかる
findings.governingReading: At a glance, anyone entering would appear to hit rock almost immediately inside.
findings.explanation: The English relocates and enlarges the obstruction into a huge boulder blocking the entrance itself.

findings.evidenceJa: 岩の向こう側に通り抜けた
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s palm passes cleanly through to the far side of the apparent rock.
findings.explanation: The English calls the destination “the space,” obscuring passage through the illusion to the other side.

findings.evidenceJa: 小さく深呼吸をして
findings.governingReading: Shirou takes a small, controlled deep breath before entering enemy territory.
findings.explanation: The English removes the deliberately slight degree.

findings.highlight: The sound of scraping on a hard surface
findings.evidenceJa: かつん、という音
findings.governingReading: The descent begins with a single hard “katsun” click or knock.
findings.explanation: The English changes a discrete impact into continuous scraping.

findings.highlight: I progress down the wet rocks using my hands
findings.evidenceJa: 水に濡れた地面を手探りで進んでいく
findings.governingReading: They feel their way along water-wet ground.
findings.explanation: The English changes ground to rocks, explicitly adds descent here, and treats using hands for orientation as climbing support.

findings.highlight: I can’t tell how far down this path goes
findings.evidenceJa: 先はどれほど暗く、地下に続いているかは判らない
findings.governingReading: Shirou cannot tell how dark the way ahead is or how far it continues underground.
findings.explanation: The English keeps distance but removes uncertainty about the darkness and subterranean extent.

findings.highlight: It’s better to have two people instead of one
findings.evidenceJa: 一人より二人の方が確実
findings.governingReading: Two people make saving Sakura more certain than one.
findings.explanation: The English turns increased certainty into a generic preference.

findings.highlight: I made a promise with her
findings.evidenceJa: 確かに約束したんだ
findings.governingReading: Rin accepted Shirou’s request and the two certainly made the promise.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the promise grammatically to Shirou and uses malformed “made a promise with.”

findings.evidenceJa: 聖杯戦争の勝者を遠坂にする
findings.governingReading: Shirou promised to make Rin the victor of the Holy Grail War.
findings.explanation: The English removes the contest being won and leaves “the victor” without an expressed field.

findings.highlight: the girl I used to admire
findings.evidenceJa: 好きだった女の子
findings.governingReading: Shirou remembers Rin as the girl he used to like or love.
findings.explanation: The English weakens personal romantic feeling into admiration.

findings.evidenceJa: 律儀ね、貴方
findings.governingReading: Rin calls Shirou scrupulous or dutiful about keeping promises.
findings.explanation: After his reference to former feelings, “faithful” invites romantic fidelity and blurs her comment on conscientious obligation.

findings.evidenceJa: 淡々と奈落へと降りていく
findings.governingReading: They descend steadily and impassively into the abyss.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the abyss image and their emotionally controlled manner.

findings.highlight: we’re over a hundred meters underground
findings.evidenceJa: 百メートル以上は進んだ
findings.governingReading: By bodily sensation Shirou judges that they have traveled more than one hundred meters.
findings.explanation: The English changes distance traveled into vertical depth underground.

findings.evidenceJa: 体の感覚で
findings.governingReading: Shirou estimates the distance through bodily sensation.
findings.explanation: The English removes the embodied basis of his estimate and makes it generic thought.

findings.evidenceJa: あまりにも生々しい
findings.governingReading: The overflowing life force feels viscerally raw and immediate.
findings.explanation: The English turns disturbing rawness into mere liveliness, weakening the horror of excessive life.

findings.highlight: An immense amount of od, and mana so strong that it’s almost visible
findings.evidenceJa: 夥しいまでの“生気”であり、視覚化できるほど垂れ流される魔力
findings.governingReading: The immense vitality is magical energy pouring out in quantities sufficient to become visible.
findings.explanation: The English coordinates od and mana as two separate accumulations and weakens actual visualizability to “almost visible.”

findings.highlight: something rotten, making me want to look away
findings.evidenceJa: 目を背けたくなる汚物
findings.governingReading: The warmth of life has become filth from which Shirou wants to avert his eyes.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes decay or rot, changing revulsion at excessive life into imagery of decomposition.

findings.evidenceJa: 意識が切れる
findings.governingReading: If Shirou relaxes, his consciousness cuts out.
findings.explanation: The English makes the loss gradual rather than abrupt.

findings.highlight: Letting the pain clear my head
findings.evidenceJa: 痛みで自分を呼び起こして
findings.governingReading: Shirou uses pain to call or awaken his dissolving self.
findings.explanation: The English reduces an identity-preservation action to ordinary mental clarity.

findings.highlight: A warm wind hits my cheeks
findings.evidenceJa: 生暖かい風が頬を撫でる
findings.governingReading: A lukewarm, unpleasantly bodylike wind strokes Shirou’s cheek.
findings.explanation: The English normalizes the temperature and changes a caress into blunt impact.

findings.highlight: It’s about as big as the schoolground
findings.evidenceJa: 横幅は学校のグラウンドほど
findings.governingReading: Only the cavern’s width is comparable to the school field.
findings.explanation: The English turns one measured dimension into overall area.

findings.evidenceJa: 忘れられた地下の広間
findings.governingReading: The cavern is a forgotten underground hall resembling a lunar wasteland.
findings.explanation: The English directly reverses “forgotten” into “unforgettable.”

findings.evidenceJa: 絶対の殺気
findings.governingReading: Saber waits wrapped in absolute killing intent.
findings.explanation: The English softens a certain lethal orientation into general hostility.

findings.evidenceJa: 桜を守る最強のサーヴァント
findings.governingReading: Saber is the strongest Servant protecting Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English changes an active protective function into Sakura’s possession of the strongest Servant.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーとまともに斬り合うハラ
findings.governingReading: Rin appears resolved to engage Saber in a proper frontal sword exchange.
findings.explanation: The English removes the sword-on-sword mechanism and the recklessness Shirou is assessing.

findings.evidenceJa: 間違いで私に剣を向けないように
findings.governingReading: Saber warns Rin not to point her sword at Saber by mistake.
findings.explanation: The English removes the mistaken-action condition and generalizes pointing a sword into attacking.

findings.highlight: Saber stops Tohsaka in her tracks
findings.evidenceJa: 戦おうとする遠坂を諌める
findings.governingReading: Saber verbally admonishes Rin as Rin prepares to fight.
findings.explanation: The English makes the effect a physical halt and drops the corrective force of Saber’s warning.

findings.highlight: We comprehend what she means right away
findings.evidenceJa: 訊くまでもなく分かってしまった
findings.governingReading: Both understand the implication without needing to ask.
findings.explanation: The English preserves immediacy but removes the shared unspoken inference and its involuntary realization.

findings.evidenceJa: ここを通る者
findings.governingReading: Saber must eliminate anyone who passes through this guarded point.
findings.explanation: “Passes by” can mean merely going near the place and blurs the gatekeeping boundary.

findings.evidenceJa: 本気なんだ、桜
findings.governingReading: Rin quietly recognizes that Sakura is serious.
findings.explanation: The English adds “must,” recasting direct recognition as deductive certainty with a different tone.

findings.evidenceJa: わたしは信頼してるんだから
findings.governingReading: Rin deliberately leaves the object of her trust unspoken while urging Shirou to meet her expectation.
findings.explanation: The English fills the withheld object with Shirou, resolving an intentionally awkward and emotionally guarded line.

findings.evidenceJa: 洞窟の闇に溶け込む寸前
findings.governingReading: Rin’s figure is on the verge of blending into the cavern darkness.
findings.explanation: The English removes the visual dissolution into darkness and reports generic disappearance.

findings.evidenceJa: 振り返らずに遠坂は奥へと消えていった
findings.governingReading: Rin proceeds into the depths without turning back.
findings.explanation: The English removes both her refusal to look back and the direction of departure.

findings.highlight: she told me to come help her
findings.evidenceJa: 遠まわしに応援してくれた
findings.governingReading: Shirou interprets Rin’s guarded words as indirect encouragement to arrive while she can restrain Sakura.
findings.explanation: The English turns his interpretation into a direct instruction and changes encouragement into a request for help.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの殺気が膨れ上がる
findings.governingReading: Saber’s killing intent swells once Rin has gone.
findings.explanation: The English again softens imminent lethal intent into hostility.

findings.highlight: she doesn’t have to hold back anymore
findings.evidenceJa: 殺気を抑える必要はない
findings.governingReading: Saber no longer needs to suppress her killing intent.
findings.explanation: The English generalizes this specific release of killing intent into holding back in every respect.

findings.highlight: your job to kill anyone that goes on from here
findings.evidenceJa: 手を出すのはここから先に進むヤツだけ
findings.governingReading: Shirou challenges whether Saber acts only against someone advancing beyond this point.
findings.explanation: The English adds killing as her “job,” hardening the condition before he has moved.

findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの忠告も聞かず
findings.governingReading: Shirou recalls repeatedly ignoring Saber’s warnings and causing trouble.
findings.explanation: The English drops both Saber as source and the warnings as what he ignored.

findings.highlight: wasn’t even using a tenth of her powers
findings.evidenceJa: 一分以下の力
findings.governingReading: In the dojo Saber used less than a small fraction of her strength against Shirou.
findings.explanation: The English fixes the fraction at one tenth, importing a precise ratio the source does not establish here.

findings.highlight: The start of the battle isn’t when the blades first meet
findings.evidenceJa: 剣技を競うところからなど始まらない
findings.governingReading: This fight does not even begin at the stage of competing in sword technique; Shirou must first find a chance to win.
findings.explanation: The English changes a hierarchy of tactical problem versus sword skill into a chronological moment of blade contact.

findings.highlight: Do you crave death so badly?
findings.evidenceJa: 一秒でも早く私に殺されたいのですか
findings.governingReading: Saber asks whether Shirou wants her to kill him even one second sooner.
findings.explanation: The English removes the time-pressure barb and turns the taunt into a general desire for death.

findings.highlight: you will come to me once you lose patience
findings.evidenceJa: 貴方の方が耐えられずに仕掛けてくる
findings.governingReading: Saber predicts Shirou will be unable to endure waiting and will initiate the attack.
findings.explanation: The English psychologizes necessity and strain as impatience.

findings.highlight: just like when I fought Berserker
findings.evidenceJa: バーサーカーを打倒した時と同じく
findings.governingReading: Shirou turns to Projection as he did when he defeated Berserker.
findings.explanation: The English removes the earlier victory that makes the tactic seem available against Saber.

findings.highlight: protect the senses from the headwind!
findings.evidenceJa: 意識がされる。切断てあしを、感覚、思考だけは、この逆風から守り抜く！
findings.governingReading: The Japanese presents ruptured cognition whose fragments retain severance, limbs, sensation, and thought under the counterflow.
findings.explanation: The English preserves gaps but drops thought as a protected faculty and recomposes the fragments into a more directed imperative.

findings.highlight: The symbol that Archer wielded for all his life
findings.evidenceJa: アーチャーが生涯の象徴とした
findings.governingReading: Archer made the paired swords the symbol of his life.
findings.explanation: The English says he wielded “the symbol,” changing an identity-defining choice into the handling of a symbolic object.

findings.evidenceJa: 錬鉄の夫婦剣
findings.governingReading: Kanshou and Bakuya are the paired or married swords of wrought/forged iron.
findings.explanation: The English changes their material to steel and removes the married-pair relation that later governs their attraction.

findings.evidenceJa: 剣としての頑丈さは折紙つき
findings.governingReading: Their sturdiness as swords is guaranteed or beyond question.
findings.explanation: The English reduces emphatic certified durability to generic strength.

findings.highlight: I can’t waste my energy like that
findings.evidenceJa: そんな無駄なコトは出来ない
findings.governingReading: Shirou says copying Saber’s sword would be pointless or futile in this situation.
findings.explanation: The English adds energy as the wasted resource, narrowing a tactical impossibility to expenditure.

findings.highlight: She holds the black holy sword
findings.evidenceJa: 音もなく黒い聖剣の柄を握り
findings.governingReading: Saber silently takes hold of the black holy sword’s hilt.
findings.explanation: The English removes both the soundless motion and the precise grip on the hilt.

findings.evidenceJa: 崩壊寸前の俺
findings.governingReading: Saber receives Shirou as he stands on the verge of physical collapse.
findings.explanation: The English states that his body is dying, promoting a broader and more ambiguous collapse into a fatal diagnosis.

findings.evidenceJa: 打ち下ろす陰剣莫耶
findings.governingReading: Shirou brings Bakuya down in an overhead/downward strike.
findings.explanation: The English removes the strike direction needed for the exchange’s choreography.

findings.highlight: concentrate everything I have in my left arm
findings.evidenceJa: 意識の全てを左腕に注ぎ込んで
findings.governingReading: Shirou pours all of his consciousness into his left arm.
findings.explanation: The English broadens the resource into everything he has and loses the cognition/body-control mechanism.

findings.highlight: her sword lunges to pierce my throat
findings.evidenceJa: 視認さえさせず俺の喉を突きに来る
findings.governingReading: Saber’s sword thrusts for Shirou’s throat without even allowing him to see it.
findings.explanation: The English preserves target and action but removes its imperceptible speed.

findings.highlight: My body moves like a superhuman
findings.evidenceJa: 超人的に翻る体
findings.governingReading: His body wheels, twists, or reverses itself with superhuman motion.
findings.explanation: The English produces an unnatural comparison to “a superhuman” and loses the specific agile reversal.

findings.highlight: I’ve already blocked thirty attacks that could’ve killed me
findings.evidenceJa: 確実に殺せる精度の一撃を、既に三十余防ぎきる
findings.governingReading: Shirou has fully defended against more than thirty blows precise enough to kill him certainly.
findings.explanation: The English removes “more than,” guaranteed lethal precision, and the completeness of his defense.

findings.highlight: My limbs can’t keep up with the extracted experience
findings.evidenceJa: 引き出される経験に肉体が追いつかない
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s whole body cannot keep pace with the experience drawn from Archer.
findings.explanation: The English narrows bodily failure to his limbs.

findings.highlight: I reproduced Archer’s battle experience along with the swords
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツの戦闘技術ごと双剣を複製した
findings.governingReading: Shirou copies Archer’s combat technique together with the paired swords.
findings.explanation: The English substitutes accumulated experience for executable skill, blurring what his body is attempting to reproduce.

findings.evidenceJa: 今の衛宮士郎の技量
findings.governingReading: At this moment Emiya Shirou’s practical combat skill approaches Archer’s.
findings.explanation: The English broadens the claim into all of Shirou’s abilities.

findings.highlight: My vision wavers with each blow I deflect
findings.evidenceJa: 引き出すごとに視界が削られる
findings.governingReading: Each act of drawing out Archer’s skill shaves away Shirou’s vision.
findings.explanation: The English assigns the visual cost to each blocked blow and weakens loss into wavering.

findings.evidenceJa: アクセルを踏み砕く
findings.governingReading: Shirou figuratively stamps hard enough to crush the accelerator.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the driving metaphor but removes its self-destructive excess.

findings.evidenceJa: もっと長く、もっと強く、このままセイバーと戦っていられる
findings.governingReading: Drawing further would let him continue fighting Saber longer and more strongly.
findings.explanation: The English removes both comparative duration and increasing strength, flattening the temptation driving him past his limit.

findings.evidenceJa: 後退する体
findings.governingReading: Saber’s blow sends Shirou’s body backward before he deliberately jumps farther back to reset.
findings.explanation: The English makes the first backward motion a jump too, collapsing forced displacement and chosen retreat.

findings.evidenceJa: 離した間合いは十メートル
findings.governingReading: The resulting interval between the fighters is ten meters.
findings.explanation: The English says Shirou’s jump itself covered exactly ten meters, confusing final range with movement distance.

findings.evidenceJa: どんなに剣を受けようと構わない
findings.governingReading: Shirou does not care how many sword blows he receives so long as none kills him instantly.
findings.explanation: The English appears to refer to Kanshou and Bakuya themselves and loses the accumulation of Saber’s strikes.

findings.highlight: I can block five more attacks from Saber
findings.evidenceJa: あと五回はセイバーの剣を受けられる
findings.governingReading: Shirou estimates that he can withstand or receive five more sword blows.
findings.explanation: The English turns bodily endurance into successful blocking, overstating defensive performance.

findings.highlight: How can you say that, knowing your condition?
findings.evidenceJa: その体でよく吠える
findings.governingReading: Saber contemptuously says he barks boldly for someone in that body.
findings.explanation: The English explains the contradiction literally and removes her animalizing taunt.

findings.highlight: I shall obliterate you with this next exchange of attacks
findings.evidenceJa: 次はその剣ごと粉砕する
findings.governingReading: Saber says next time she will pulverize Shirou together with those swords.
findings.explanation: The English omits destruction of Kanshou and Bakuya and invents a generalized exchange of attacks.

findings.highlight: with the swords I have right now
findings.evidenceJa: 唯一許されたこの投影で
findings.governingReading: Shirou believes he must defeat Saber using the single remaining Projection permitted to him.
findings.explanation: The English replaces his reserved final Projection with the swords already in his hands, breaking the resource logic that Saber challenges next.

findings.evidenceJa: 歪みに歪み、崩れに崩れた思考
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s thought has become extremely warped and collapsed through bodily destruction.
findings.explanation: The English labels him crazy, substituting a psychiatric characterization for structural cognitive failure.

findings.highlight: Sakura is facing Tohsaka without her greatest protection
findings.evidenceJa: 桜は最強の守り手を欠いたまま
findings.governingReading: Sakura faces Rin while deprived of her strongest guardian, Saber.
findings.explanation: The English turns a person actively guarding Sakura into abstract “protection,” weakening Saber’s assigned role.

findings.highlight: keep Saber from going to her Master
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーを桜の下に行かさない
findings.governingReading: Shirou must keep Saber from returning to Sakura specifically.
findings.explanation: The English replaces Sakura with her formal Master role, reducing the immediate personal and tactical referent.

findings.evidenceJa: 自分のものでなくなった心
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s heart is no longer his own alongside a body without sensation.
findings.explanation: The English changes alienation of the heart into a mind that lacks any self, escalating figurative estrangement into ontological absence.

findings.highlight: If my wish can be granted
findings.evidenceJa: それがそれが叶うのなら
findings.governingReading: If saving Sakura can be achieved, Shirou no longer cares about the process.
findings.explanation: The English turns the repeated concrete referent into an abstract personal wish.

findings.highlight: if I give her the chance
findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に繋げる事が出来れば
findings.governingReading: Even if Shirou cannot accomplish the rescue, it has meaning if he can connect or pass the attempt onward to Rin.
findings.explanation: The English reduces succession and entrusted responsibility to giving Rin an opportunity.

findings.evidenceJa: きっと桜を助けてくれる
findings.governingReading: Shirou trusts that Rin will surely save Sakura if he passes the task to her.
findings.explanation: The English omits his confidence marker and the explicit object of rescue.

findings.highlight: these twin swords are the only weapons I’m going to read
findings.evidenceJa: 読み込むするのはあくまでこの双剣のみ
findings.governingReading: The source presents a visibly ruptured loading verb as Shirou’s cognition fails, while limiting the read to the paired swords.
findings.explanation: The English repairs the broken syntax into a complete planned action and adds “weapons.”

findings.evidenceJa: 性能を把握していない
findings.governingReading: Shirou has not yet grasped the weapon’s properties or performance.
findings.explanation: The English adds “full,” implying partial comprehension rather than an unqualified lack of grasp.

findings.highlight: the remaining forty percent of my mind
findings.evidenceJa: 残っていた四割の意識
findings.governingReading: Four tenths of Shirou’s remaining consciousness or awareness falls to two.
findings.explanation: The English labels the measured remainder his mind, inviting an intelligence or organ reading rather than continuity of awareness.

findings.highlight: I forget the names of a lot of things
findings.evidenceJa: 色々なものの名称が失われた
findings.governingReading: The names of many things disappear from Shirou’s cognition, including his own.
findings.explanation: The English makes Shirou the active experiencer of ordinary forgetting and weakens systemic loss.

findings.highlight: the stance that will guarantee a kill
findings.evidenceJa: ヤツが必至とした構え
findings.governingReading: Shirou searches for the stance or method Archer treated as desperate or indispensable.
findings.explanation: The English makes the stance itself guarantee a kill, overstating the tactic before it confronts Saber’s defense.

findings.highlight: to get him through the countless battles
findings.evidenceJa: 多くの戦いを制してきた
findings.governingReading: Archer used the technique to win many battles.
findings.explanation: The English changes victory into survival or passage and adds “countless.”

findings.highlight: I draw from the well of experience
findings.evidenceJa: 経験のイドから水を汲む
findings.governingReading: Shirou draws water from the id or deep unconscious reservoir of experience.
findings.explanation: The English keeps the well image but removes the specifically named psychic depth.

findings.evidenceJa: 剣術自体は基本を守る
findings.governingReading: The swordsmanship itself adheres to its fundamentals.
findings.explanation: The English turns a description of the technique into an imperative addressed within Shirou’s thoughts.

findings.highlight:
Divine skill, flawless and firm
Strength moves mountains
Blade cuts water
Life approaches the Imperial Villa
Two great men, shared life
findings.evidenceJa:
鶴翼不欠落
心技至泰山
心技渡黄河
唯名納別天
両雄倶別命
findings.governingReading: The five-line paired-sword verse invokes crane wings, mind and technique reaching Mount Tai and crossing the Yellow River, a name offered to another heaven, and two heroes parting with life.
findings.explanation: The English replaces or reverses central images across the verse, including crane wings, Mount Tai, the Yellow River, and parting with life.

findings.evidenceJa: 敵はわずかに腰を落とす
findings.governingReading: The enemy lowers her hips slightly into a prepared stance.
findings.explanation: The English reports readiness but removes the visible posture used to stage the next exchange.

findings.evidenceJa: あの敵の名前は、まだ、
findings.governingReading: Although all names have shattered, the enemy’s name still remains on the edge of recall.
findings.explanation: The English turns the fragment into the start of a naming statement and loses the contrast that this name alone may remain.

findings.evidenceJa: 敵上で交差するように
findings.governingReading: The two arcing swords are thrown to cross above or over the enemy.
findings.explanation: The English relocates the intersection directly onto her body, changing the trajectory geometry.

findings.evidenceJa: 鉄塊をも撃ち砕く
findings.governingReading: A single Noble Phantasm blow can smash even a mass of iron.
findings.explanation: The English changes blunt destructive force and an iron mass into penetration of steel.

findings.evidenceJa: いかな豪傑であろうと
findings.governingReading: No mighty fighter could emerge unscathed from the simultaneous attack.
findings.explanation: The English narrows formidable combatants into heroes, adding a moral or mythic category.

findings.evidenceJa: 破られた
findings.governingReading: Shirou recognizes that the paired-sword attack has been defeated or broken.
findings.explanation: The English says Saber escaped it, shifting the result from active destruction of the tactic to evasion.

findings.evidenceJa: 凍結、解除
findings.governingReading: Shirou releases or cancels the prepared freeze state.
findings.explanation: “Freeze, out” is malformed English and obscures the release command.

findings.evidenceJa: 予め準備しておいた干将莫耶
findings.governingReading: Shirou manifests the Kanshou and Bakuya Projection prepared in advance.
findings.explanation: The English introduces a prepared mental image and weakens the distinction between prior preparation and present manifestation.

findings.evidenceJa: 私には届かない
findings.governingReading: Saber says that Noble Phantasm cannot reach or land on her.
findings.explanation: The English changes attack reach into overall equivalence with Saber.

findings.evidenceJa: 未来予知じみた勘の良さ
findings.governingReading: Saber’s extraordinarily sharp instinct resembles precognition.
findings.explanation: The English says “cognition-like,” losing the future-sight comparison and producing an incoherent modifier.

findings.highlight: she blocks it with her sword
findings.evidenceJa: 敵の剣の前に砕かれた
findings.governingReading: Bakuya is shattered against or before Saber’s sword.
findings.explanation: The English records only a block and removes destruction of the frontal sword, which is required for the weapon accounting.

findings.highlight: she destroys Bakuya that I attacked with
findings.evidenceJa: 正面から斬り伏せにいった莫耶を打ち砕く
findings.governingReading: Saber smashes Bakuya as Shirou brings it down against her from the front.
findings.explanation: The English loses direction and action structure and renders the attack in malformed idiom.

findings.highlight: She even blocks my final attack
findings.evidenceJa: 最後の一撃さえ、この敵は打ち砕いた
findings.governingReading: The enemy shatters even the last Kanshou strike.
findings.explanation: The English reduces weapon destruction to blocking, again obscuring the state needed for the next Projection.

findings.evidenceJa: 一秒に満たない刹那
findings.governingReading: The fighters assess each other in a moment lasting less than one second.
findings.explanation: The English removes the explicit upper bound that organizes the final opening.

findings.highlight: the simultaneous attack from four blades
findings.evidenceJa: 四つの刃による前後からの同時攻撃
findings.governingReading: Saber has stopped four blades attacking simultaneously from front and rear.
findings.explanation: The English preserves simultaneity and count but removes the decisive two-direction geometry.

findings.highlight: in a second we’ll be back where we started
findings.evidenceJa: 一秒の後に元に戻る
findings.governingReading: Their moment of complete exposure will end after one second as they regain functional combat states.
findings.explanation: The English suggests a return to initial positions or circumstances rather than recovery from the frozen deadlock.

findings.evidenceJa: この手には、その先が用意されている
findings.governingReading: Shirou has prepared something in his hands beyond the apparent deadlock.
findings.explanation: The English removes both preparation and the hand-based weapon reveal.

findings.evidenceJa: 三度目を超えて、その先へ
findings.governingReading: Shirou goes beyond the third Projection and then farther still.
findings.explanation: The English retains limit transgression but removes the counted Projection boundary.

findings.evidenceJa: 両雄、共ニ命ヲ別ツ
findings.governingReading: The written line has the two heroes part with life together, while its ruby reads “we do not embrace heaven together.”
findings.explanation: The mature English branch states the opposite of the ruby by making them embrace heaven together.

findings.evidenceJa: 両雄、共ニ命ヲ別ツ
findings.governingReading: The written line says both heroes part with life together.
findings.explanation: The Realta English branch changes parting with life into sharing life.

findings.highlight: I say her name in my final moments
findings.evidenceJa: 最後の最後で、彼女の名前を口にした
findings.governingReading: At the very last instant Shirou remembers and says Saber’s name.
findings.explanation: The English turns the tactic’s final instant into Shirou’s final moments, prematurely framing him as dying.

findings.evidenceJa: 沈むように、眠りにつこう
findings.governingReading: Shirou decides to sink into sleep for a brief while.
findings.explanation: The English preserves short sleep but removes the sinking image that marks his loss of consciousness.

findings.evidenceJa: 自由になる個所が一つたりとも存在しなかった
findings.governingReading: For that one second Saber has not a single bodily part free to respond.
findings.explanation: The English narrows total bodily lockout to occupied limbs.

findings.highlight: One has to crush her head or heart
findings.evidenceJa: 確実に心臓か頭を潰すしかない
findings.governingReading: Defeating Saber now requires certainly destroying either heart or head.
findings.explanation: The English preserves targets but drops the requirement of reliable, complete destruction.

findings.highlight: she cannot do anything for ten minutes and has to accept any finishing blows
findings.evidenceJa: とどめの一撃を甘受するしかない
findings.governingReading: For roughly ten minutes Saber can only submit to a finishing blow before regeneration.
findings.explanation: The English adds total inability to do anything and pluralizes the finishing blow.

findings.evidenceJa: 少年の傷とて命に関わる深さ
findings.governingReading: The boy’s wounds are deep enough to threaten his life, though he retains ample capacity compared with Saber.
findings.explanation: The English declares the wounds fatal while simultaneously saying he should still move, overstating the diagnosis.

findings.highlight: Accepting her impending death, she calls out
findings.evidenceJa: あと数秒の後に消滅する自分を受け入れ、彼女は懐かしむように声をかける
findings.governingReading: Saber accepts that she will vanish in a few seconds and addresses Shirou with nostalgic warmth.
findings.explanation: The English removes the short deadline, Servant disappearance, and nostalgic quality.

findings.evidenceJa: 少年の意思は砕け散っていた
findings.governingReading: Shirou’s will has shattered without a trace while his body remains alive.
findings.explanation: The English changes destruction of volition into destruction of the mind, implying broader cognitive annihilation.

findings.highlight: enemies risk their lives and die meaninglessly
findings.evidenceJa: 命を捨てて尚届かなかった敵の末路
findings.governingReading: Saber has repeatedly seen the ends of enemies who discarded their lives and still failed to reach her.
findings.explanation: The English weakens deliberate life-discarding to risk, omits failure to reach her, and judges the deaths meaningless.

findings.highlight: A hero is someone who cuts down his foes using everything he has
findings.evidenceJa: あらゆる努力、あらゆる犠牲をしいて挑む敵を、息を吸うが如く斬り伏せるのが英雄
findings.governingReading: A hero cuts down as easily as breathing the enemies who challenge him after imposing every effort and sacrifice on themselves.
findings.explanation: The English assigns “using everything he has” to the hero instead of the desperate challengers and removes the effortless-breathing comparison.

findings.evidenceJa: 横たわったまま
findings.governingReading: Saber addresses Rin and looks upward while still lying where she fell.
findings.explanation: The English removes her continuing prone position.

findings.evidenceJa: 一際高い振動
findings.governingReading: A particularly strong or high vibration arises in the distance.
findings.explanation: The English removes its exceptional degree, weakening the only evidence from the sisters’ battle.

findings.highlight: Her heart contains only the slightest trace of pity
findings.evidenceJa: 胸に擁くものがあるとすれば、それは小さな哀れみだけ
findings.governingReading: If Saber holds anything in her breast, it is only a small pity.
findings.explanation: The English removes the conditional qualification and asserts pity as her sole internal content.
